waiting.stoppedText: The session was stopped before this phase finished.

independent.blind: Blind phase: every model receives the identical brief and works in its own request. No model sees another answer, and nobody sees any proposal until all models have finished. Then all proposals are revealed at once.
independent.networkCaption: Each node is one model. Nodes float gently; a node pulses only while its request is in flight.
independent.tooFew: {arrived} of {total} proposals arrived – too few for a council, so no debate or verdict followed. The proposal is readable in the council room, marked as incomplete.
independent.revealed: {n} proposals revealed. Continue with Open Council.
independent.submitted: {submitted} of {total} proposals submitted – contents stay hidden until the reveal.

open.waiting: Proposals appear here after the simultaneous reveal.
open.neutral: All proposals in neutral order. No winner is declared in this phase.

minds.perspectivesNote: Several perspectives on the same model are one independent voice when majorities are counted.

minds.counts: {critiques, plural, one {# critique} other {# critiques}} · {open} not conceded

minority.waiting: Dissenting objections are reviewed separately before any consensus is formed.

evaluationScreen.hintDebate: Consider “Request more debate” to re-run the missing evaluations, or compare the alternatives before approving.

mainReason.title: Main reason: the evaluation is incomplete.

evaluationScreen.eligibleButBlocked: Passes the gates, but cannot be approved in this council – see Final Verdict.

verdictScreen.otherGateMany: {proposals} meet the confirmed requirements but did not pass another gate (security minimum, minimum score or a blocking objection) – see Evaluation.

verdictScreen.archChangeAdopted: Architecture change: revision v{version} replaced the solution of v1 and resembles Proposal {from} – the content is not only the author's own.
verdictScreen.mootSummary: {n, plural, one {# objection against an earlier revision no longer applies} other {# objections against an earlier revision no longer apply}}
verdictScreen.mootItem: {claim} – raised against v{against}; no longer applies to v{current} (not independently re-reviewed)
verdictScreen.conflictText: The proposals conclude, and the independent evaluators confirm, that the hard requirements cannot be met together. A good analysis of that is not a solution: nothing can be built under these requirements. Confirm the finding with “Reject” (no build), or change the requirements – a changed brief needs a new council and a new approval.
verdictScreen.tieText: The leading proposals are too close to call. Choose an alternative with a reason, or request more debate.
verdictScreen.noRecommendation: The council could not recommend a solution. You can request more debate, request changes to the brief or reject.

form.title: Your decision
form.intro: Nothing is developed without your approval. Proposals blocked by a critical security objection, and findings that the requirements cannot be met, cannot be approved for implementation.
form.repeat: Repeat the evaluation ({n, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} without scores)
form.requestChangesS1: Request changes – then edit the brief or requirements and start a new council
form.rejectConflict: Reject – confirm the finding, no build
form.onlyOwners: Only owners and admins can approve decisions.

reasons.needsVerification: Needs verification – the council could not confirm that a proposal meets every requirement. It cannot be approved or built.
reasons.notQualified: This proposal does not meet every confirmed requirement according to the evaluations (or it could not be confirmed). It cannot be approved or built. Change the brief or the requirements and start a new council.
reasons.limitedReview: Too few independent models checked this proposal (at least 2 are needed). It is a provisional favourite and cannot be approved or built. Start a new council with at least 3 models.
reasons.unknownOutcome: This verdict uses a result this version does not know. It cannot be approved or built here.

requirementGate.title: Confirmed requirements per proposal
requirementGate.intro: A requirement counts as met only if every expected evaluator confirmed every part of it with a reason. PASS and FAIL are stored model judgements with reasons, not an independent fact check.
requirementGate.estimate: Estimated by {n, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}: {low}–{high}{unit} (median {median}) · limit {relation} {limit}{unit}. Met only if every range keeps the limit.
